broad_screen.dataset: 900 per geometry, 320 RF periods, 32 RK4 steps/period

criteria.late_opposite_sign_only: survived; each particle has same nonzero sign in each of its final two windows; the signs differ between particles
criteria.ten_turn_screen_candidate: late_opposite_sign_only, at least 10 total turns for each particle, and at least 1 turn by each particle in its final window
criteria.scope: screen only; a candidate would still require perturbation, parameter robustness, and independent integrator validation
